title: El Dorado Canyon, Ghost Town & Gold Mine / Guided Walking Tour
blurb:
Experience El Dorado Canyon and its wild west history! Your walking tour guide will show you inside the old mine and bring to life its intriguing history and lore.
After, walk around the old ghost town, pick up souvenirs and take lots of photos before we head back to Las Vegas.
This will be a memorable event that you and your companions will reminisce on.
